scoring_justification: Artifacts are final FEM simulation result tables; re-running the whole FEM simulation in the checker is infeasible. Compare submitted values to paper-reported reference values and structural constraints with appropriate tolerances.

outputs.description: Resonance wavelength and peak loss of the y-polarized core mode for the baseline D-shaped PCF SPR sensor at temperatures 270, 320, and 370 K.
Peak loss as a function of analyte RI at temperatures 270, 320, and 370 K.
Peak loss as a function of temperature for fixed analyte RI=1.35.
Resonance wavelength and peak loss for duty ratio 0.4, 0.6 and lattice pitch 5 µm, 10 µm at temperatures 270, 320, and 370 K.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the full temperature-dependent material models (Sellmeier for fused silica, Drude for gold with temperature-corrected plasma and collision frequencies, and film thickness correction) using the parameters from the paper. An open-source or proprietary full-vectorial FEM solver with cylindrical PML must be used to compute complex effective indices and confinement losses. The output values are compared to hidden reference values derived from the paper’s reported simulation results.
